concepts.def: Electrostatic attraction between cation and anion formed by electron transfer; large electronegativity difference.
Shared pair of electrons between non-metal atoms; Lewis 1916 dot structures.
Lattice of cations in sea of delocalised electrons; explains conductivity and malleability.
Electron pairs minimise repulsion; predicts molecular shape (Gillespie & Nyholm 1957).
Intermolecular force when H bonded to N, O, F interacts with lone pair on N, O, F of another molecule.
Delocalised electrons in structures like benzene or carbonate; actual structure is hybrid of canonical forms.
